name: mdcp-monorepo
description: MDCP — documentation system Agent Skill (MarkDown Context Protocol)

scripts.vale:sync: mkdir -p examples/sample-guides/styles docs/styles && (cd examples/sample-guides && vale sync) && (cd docs && vale sync)
scripts.prepare:docs: pnpm run verify:peers && pnpm run vale:sync
scripts.docs:check:repo: pnpm run docs:lint:changeset-links && node packages/mdcp-cli/dist/cli.js check --config docs/mdcp.config.json --docs-root docs --require-lint --require-vale
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run docs:check:repo && pnpm run docs:check:examples
scripts.presentation:render: pnpm run presentation:compile && slidev build presentations/la-devops-2026.md --out ../build/presentations/dist
scripts.presentation:render:pdf: pnpm run presentation:compile && slidev export presentations/la-devops-2026.md --output build/presentations/la-devops-2026.pdf
scripts.presentation:verify: pnpm run presentation:compile && slidev export presentations/la-devops-2026.md --format png --output .tmp/slides/
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run skill:lint && pnpm run skill:validate && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.skill:validate: skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp-getting-started && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp-doc-only && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp-design-architecture && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp-feature-level && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp-ux && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp-arch-oss-library && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp-arch-product-docs-site
scripts.docs:compile: pnpm run docs:compile:repo && pnpm run docs:compile:examples
